question: What benefit follows from seeing Mādhava on the great Jyaiṣṭhī day?
premises: The observance occurs on the great Jyaiṣṭhī day.
The act is addressed as significant to the lord of men.
inference: Seeing Mādhava on the great Jyaiṣṭhī day is a prescribed observance.
uncertainties: The specific benefit is implied but not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Whoever may see Mādhava on the great Jyaiṣṭhī day, O lord of men...
